caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher with a brown color, featuring a rounded body, a curved handle on the left side, and a wide mouth at the top. The top of the pitcher is broken, displaying an irregular jagged edge where a section of the rim is missing. The background is plain and off-white, with a fine square border drawn around the pitcher. A dashed line is illustrated above the broken rim to indicate the original contour of the pitcher’s opening before it was broken. The artist's signature, "Annie B. Johnston," is visible in the bottom right corner outside the square border.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
